CustomField.description: This field directs students during the event to indicate their interest in attending a Barrett Tour by using check box.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field outlines the procedure during the check-in process for a campaign on the same day, if a student plans to attend a Barrett session later that day, they should either click the checkbox (if interested) or leave it unchecked (if not interested).
CustomField.label: Barrett Session
